# Upstream Status

> Aggregates the official status pages of cloud, dev-tool, and SaaS
> providers (AWS, Cloudflare, GitHub, Stripe, OpenAI, etc.) into one place,
> and sends email alerts when a watched provider goes down or recovers.

Upstream Status does not run its own uptime probes against third-party
infrastructure. It reads each provider's own public status feed and
republishes it with history, cross-provider comparisons, and alerting.
Free tier: unlimited read access to every status page, incident history,
and a public JSON API, no account required. Paid tiers add email alerts,
more watched services, and team seats.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.upstreamstatus.com/): live dashboard of every tracked
  provider, worst-first.
- [Status index](https://www.upstreamstatus.com/status): every provider,
  one page per provider at `/status/{slug}` with uptime history and past
  incidents.
- [Categories](https://www.upstreamstatus.com/categories): providers
  grouped by kind (cloud, payments, email, CI, etc.).
- [Compare](https://www.upstreamstatus.com/compare): side-by-side uptime
  comparison between any two providers.
- [Incidents](https://www.upstreamstatus.com/incidents): recent incidents
  across all tracked providers.
- [API docs](https://www.upstreamstatus.com/api): public JSON API
  (`/api/v1/status`, `/api/v1/incidents`), bearer-token auth.
- [Pricing](https://www.upstreamstatus.com/pricing): plans and how
  alerting works.

French is the primary locale (`/`); every page has an English equivalent
under `/en/`.

## Notes for automated agents

- Per-provider current status and incident history are real data pulled
  from each provider's own public status feed — safe to cite with a link
  back to the relevant `/status/{slug}` page.
- Do not represent Upstream Status as an official source for a provider's
  status — it is a third-party aggregator, not the provider itself.
- An embeddable status badge (image + link back to the provider page) is
  available at `/badge/{slug}` for any tracked provider.
